translate_en|mods/NaturesCall/42.16/medi: Poo on the ground and wipe
Automatically flush the toilet after using it (when it has water).

Writes your Nature's Call data (bladder/bowel, digestion queue, intake log, options, traits, worn clothing and the active mod list) to Zomboid/Lua/NaturesCall_debug.txt. If you have a bug, click this, then send or paste that file.
Opens or closes the Nature's Call panel.
Push the Nature's Call sidebar icon down by N slots to avoid overlap with other mods' icons. 0 = default position.
Bug reporting: save your Nature's Call data to a text file.
Open or close the standalone Nature's Call panel.
Show a small draggable bladder/bowel bar overlay on the HUD.
No intake logged in the last %1 days.
Show a small floating bar overlay (bladder/bowel) you can drag anywhere. The full panel still opens with TAB.
Controls the volume of all Nature's Call sound effects.
Dried feces damage has been applied
Lower control makes accidents more likely.
Better control makes accidents less likely and helps you hold on longer.
You can have bowel accidents while asleep.
You can have bladder accidents while asleep.
Your bladder fills more slowly, so you need to pee less often.
Your bowels fill more slowly, so you need to poo less often.
Poor food affects your gut more strongly, and accidents tend to be worse.
Dairy causes extra bowel pressure and can trigger cramps more easily.
Soiled clothing no longer causes discomfort, unhappiness, or bad-smell penalties.
Your bladder meter is hidden. Accidents can happen at any fill level and empty your bladder completely.
Your bowel meter is hidden. Accidents can happen at any fill level and empty your bowels completely.
Body soilage will not cause rashes or infections.
You can only pee in toilets, diapers, and containers.
You can only poo in toilets and diapers
Your bladder fills faster, so you need to pee more often.
Your bowels fill faster, so you need to poo more often.
Soiled clothing causes more discomfort and unhappiness.
Your bladder meter stays visible, but accidents can happen before you are full and release part of your bladder.
Your bowel meter stays visible, but accidents can happen before you are full and release part of your bowels.
An accident could happen any moment!
Your bowels are asking for release.

Your stomach is starting to cramp.
Your gut is twisting and it is getting hard to relax.
Sharp cramping keeps hitting your abdomen.
Your stomach pain is intense and hard to ignore.
Your digestion feels a little off.
Your recent diet is making digestion harder to manage.
Poor gut health is starting to drag you down.
Your gut is in bad shape and everything feels worse because of it.
Your gut feels calm and stable.
Good habits are paying off with steady digestion and better comfort.
Your digestion is working in your favor.
Your body feels balanced, resilient, and comfortable.
A faint burn is building in your chest.
Acid is climbing and making you uncomfortable.
The burning in your chest is distracting and unpleasant.
Your chest and throat are burning badly.
The stench nearby is hard to ignore.
The smell and discomfort are becoming harder to ignore.
That's a serious mess you got there.
You need to clean up immediately, gross.
Something is not right in your pants. You should check them.
Multiplier applied to chance-based accidents from fill pressure, overflow, and incontinence.
Multiplier applied to how much is released and how harsh the consequences are for non-forced accidents.
Multiplier applied to bladder filling over time.
Multiplier applied to bowel filling over time.

Minimum accumulated scale (servings) before a food category's per-hour effects (bowel rate, control, mood, sleepiness) start applying. Higher values mean you must eat more of a category in a short window before its effects engage. Default 1.0 means roughly 2-3 servings.
Multiplier applied to the per-hour magnitude of active food category effects and binge penalties. Higher values make the effects hit harder while active. Default 1.5.

How fast a food category's effect fades per game hour once you stop eating it. Higher means effects wear off quicker. Default 0.50: a heavy meal's effect lasts about 1-3 hours and a single snack fades in well under an hour.

When checked, gut health stays at a constant neutral and your diet no longer causes cramps, diarrhea, constipation, heartburn or any other good/bad gut effects. Eating and drinking still track and fill your bladder and bowels, and you can still get sick from rotten or tainted food and normal vanilla food effects. Can be changed mid-game (single-player and multiplayer).

Multiplier applied to the duration of stomach effects (cramps, heartburn, diarrhea, constipation, laxative, sugar/water/caffeine highs, binge fatigue) when they are triggered or extended. Lower values let effects wear off faster.
Multiplier applied to how quickly gut health improves or worsens from diet.
Multiplier applied to discomfort and unhappiness from wearing soiled clothing. Set to 0 to disable these penalties.
Multiplier applied to unhappiness from using unflushed toilets and to nearby foul-toilet smell severity. Set to 0 to disable these penalties.
Multiplier applied to trait modifiers such as fill rates, control, soilage penalties, and accident scaling.
Multiplier applied to relief and wiping action duration.
Multiplier applied to wipe supply consumption when cleaning after relief and accidents.
Multiplier applied to zombie attraction radius from player soilage, dropped soiled items, exposed waste, and foul toilets. Set to 0 to disable smell-based attraction.
